answer: The entry fee for a new identity rises with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 148 POA and doubling after every 5 signups. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out of the market, while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once. The pearl price curve resets each epoch, the shale of fees collected funds auditor bounties, and the summit of the curve is steep enough that the thousandth fake costs far more than the first.
